classificationKinds.intro: Each profile run tests a sample of every column's values against these kinds. Where enough values pass, the column gets a suggestion a data steward accepts or rejects. A disabled kind is not tested.

test.us_ssn: Nine digits, written 123-45-6789 or plain: the area is never 000, 666 or 900 to 999, the group never 00, the serial never 0000.
test.payment_card: 13 to 19 digits, spaces or dashes allowed between groups, passing the Luhn check.
test.iban: A country code, two check digits and up to 30 letters and digits whose check digits are right (mod 97).
test.uk_national_insurance_number: Two prefix letters of the allowed set, six digits and a final letter A to D.
test.ca_social_insurance_number: Nine digits, the first not 0 or 8, passing the Luhn check.
test.es_dni: Eight digits and their check letter; a foreigner's NIE starts with X, Y or Z.
test.nl_bsn: Nine digits passing the eleven test.
test.in_aadhaar: Twelve digits, the first 2 to 9, passing the Verhoeff check.
test.us_passport: A letter and eight digits, the format of US passports issued since 2021.
test.us_ein: Two digits of an IRS campus prefix, a hyphen and seven digits, written 12-3456789.
test.us_itin: Nine digits starting with 9, the middle two in an ITIN group (50 to 65, 70 to 88, 90 to 92, 94 to 99), written 912-70-1234 or plain.
test.us_bank_routing_number: Nine digits passing the ABA checksum.
test.de_steuer_id: Eleven digits, the first not 0, with the repeated-digit rule and the MOD 11,10 check digit.
test.fr_nir: Thirteen characters (a department of 2A or 2B for Corsica) and their two-digit key.
test.au_tfn: Nine digits passing the TFN weighted checksum.
test.br_cpf: Eleven digits, not all alike, ending in the two CPF check digits, written 123.456.789-09 or plain.
test.uk_nhs_number: Ten digits passing the NHS mod 11 check.
test.aws_access_key_id: AKIA or ASIA followed by 16 capital letters or digits.
test.github_token: A ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_ or ghr_ prefix and 36 or more letters or digits, or a github_pat_ token.
test.jwt: Three base64url segments, the first a JSON header that names an alg.
test.email_address: A local part of at most 64 characters, an @ and a domain with at least one dot.
test.e164_phone: A plus sign, a country code not starting with 0, and 7 to 15 digits in all, with spaces, hyphens or brackets allowed.
test.ipv4_address: Four numbers from 0 to 255 separated by dots, without leading zeros.
test.ipv6_address: Up to eight groups of one to four hex digits separated by colons, with one run of zero groups written ::.
test.country: A country name from the shipped list of countries.
test.country_code: A two- or three-letter ISO 3166 country code.
test.language_code: A two- or three-letter ISO 639 language code.
test.city: The name of a city of 15,000 people or more, from the shipped list.

noun.us_itin: a US individual taxpayer identification number
